name: Boonlake

endCondition.description: Fourth interim scoring (a ship reaches the last river space; round finishes to equal turns), then final scoring.

categories.label: Victory points after 4th interim scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track sau lần chấm thứ 4
categories.hint: VP marker value (incl. 100/200 marker) before final scoring.

categories.label: Levers on player board
categories.hint: 4-6 levers: 2 VP each; 7 or more: 3 VP each.

categories.label: Played cards
categories.labelVi: Điểm các lá bài đã chơi
categories.hint: Sum of points on the symbol of every played card.

categories.label: Tier 3 recesses emptied
categories.hint: 2 VP per emptied recess in the third tier.

categories.label: Tier 4 recesses emptied
categories.hint: 4 VP per emptied recess in the fourth tier.

categories.label: Tier 5 recesses emptied
categories.hint: 6 VP per emptied recess in the fifth tier.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker; all tied players win.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Leftover coins and cards score nothing. Final scoring happens after the 4th interim scoring, whose own points (unused levers, cattle, income, scoring tile) should already be on the VP track. Solo mode vs the Wise Eminence not modelled.
